retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast psychedelic composition featuring figures emerging from a swirling, fiery lava-like texture framed by a double-line border and stylized bubble typography.
excludeWhen: modern flat vector illustration is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition with a thick white outer margin and a black double-line inner frame. The central image is a dense, high-contrast collage of four figures appearing to float or emerge from a chaotic, swirling texture of orange, red, and black 'lava' against a vibrant magenta backdrop. The top section features large, stylized bubble lettering with a thick outline and a swooping underline.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant magenta background contrasting with dark lava foreground
Heavy display typography anchored to the top edge
Double-line border framing the central chaos
coreInvariants: High-contrast swirling texture in red and black
Magenta color field visible through texture gaps

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four human figures distributed horizontally across the center, partially obscured by texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, purple-filled display type at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title at the top, down through the swirling lava texture to the figures, then out to the white border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal within the frame; significant white space provided by the thick outer margin.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black swirling texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the magenta and orange tones with deep, crushed blacks in the texture.

letterConstructionRules: Extended swash or underline on the primary word
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features a long, curved tail that underlines the subsequent letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a smaller, similarly rounded bubble style with flame-like decorative outlines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick white border and a black double-line inner frame. Inside the frame, create a chaotic, high-contrast swirling texture of red, orange, and black lava over a bright magenta background. Include four human figures in vintage 60s clothing emerging from the texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, purple bubble-style lettering at the top with a thick white outline and a long curved underline swash. Add smaller secondary bubble text with flame-like outlines below the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta background visible through the lava texture?
Does the main title have a thick white outline?
Is the double-line border present with notched corners?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the collage
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the double-line border.
Ensure the texture feels like a physical collage or liquid swirl.
Verify the magenta and orange contrast is high.
Confirm the typography is rounded and heavily outlined.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast liquid texture overlay with a vibrant solid background, frame with a classic double-line border, and top with heavy bubble-style display lettering.
